1.32.0.note: 2026-11-21: OCR-11 (owner decision 2026-11-21): a read that found nothing on the page is a failed read. The approval read whose page IMAGE is (nearly) all white (income_declaration.approval_page_white: under 0.2% ink pixels) fails with no paid call, one sweep retry, then the officer's; a genuine unmarked document stays a checked, unapproved read. The student verdict no longer counts a reader's bookkeeping fields, or a list or dict with nothing filled inside, as read (vision/judge._any_field_filled); an all-empty AI answer on the results slip or higher results is a failed read (vision/field_extraction._empty_answer_failed). Review round 1: those three definitions and read_errors.EMPTY_ANSWER are now pins of this model, so the digest moved from 1.31.0's.

1.33.0.note: 2026-11-21: OCR-11 review round 2. The white check judges no image over 16 MP (income_declaration.WHITE_CHECK_MAX_PIXELS, read from the header; a JPEG after its reduced-scale draft) and no 16/32-bit or float image (modes I, I;16, F): both are not white, so the approval read goes ahead as before 1.32.0. The pins are now the callers (income_declaration.read_approval, vision/field_extraction._read_higher_results), whose closures hold the checks, so deleting the white check, the one-retry window close or the higher-results empty check moves the digest.

1.34.0.note: 2026-11-21: OCR-11 review round 3. The white check opens only income_declaration.WHITE_CHECK_FORMATS (JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, WEBP; HEIF only while pillow_heif has registered it): PIL's ICO opener decodes the whole image inside open, before any size check (a 580 kB ICO of a 12000 x 12000 PNG took ~600 MB). An image over 16 MP that is not a baseline JPEG is not white BEFORE the draft: libjpeg holds a progressive JPEG's full-size buffer whatever the scale (a 2 MB 13000 x 13000 one took ~1 GB). The draft also covers MPO. Both are not white, so the approval read goes ahead as before 1.32.0.

1.35.0.note: 2026-11-21: OCR-11 review round 4. The 16 MP cap (income_declaration.WHITE_CHECK_MAX_PIXELS) applies to EVERY format by the header size, before any draft or decode: a baseline (SOF0/SOF1) JPEG with one scan per colour is not marked progressive, yet libjpeg holds its full buffer whatever the scale (158-177 byte 13000 x 13000 files peaked 361-1,383 MB). So a white 48/50 MP phone photo gets the paid read as before 1.32.0. TIFF is removed from WHITE_CHECK_FORMATS: a 1 MB TIFF with a 64 x 64 header and one 16384 x 16384 tile peaked ~1.1 GB and read white; a TIFF page now gets the paid read. Every over-cap round 3 and round 4 repro and the tiled TIFF now peak at 21-24 MB.

1.36.0.note: 2026-11-26: TD-701. The white check (income_declaration.approval_page_white) pastes a transparent page in greyscale (an L page with the alpha channel as mask; a P image with transparency converts to RGBA first) instead of building four full-size RGBA copies (16 MP RGBA: about 192 MB over baseline before, 47 MB now), and HEIF is dropped from the formats it opens (HEIC is already converted to JPEG at upload), so a HEIF page is not judged white and gets the paid read. Verdicts for JPEG/PNG/GIF/BMP/WEBP are unchanged.

1.37.0.note: 2026-11-28: OCR-16. The QR + crest read (results_visual_markers) only. The read goes through genuineness/ai_model.ask behind the GENUINENESS_MODEL setting. Default (unset) = the 2.5 Flash cascade exactly as before: same prompt, same schema, one call, same parsed result, so no stored answer changes while the setting is unset. Set to a 3.8 Flash name (the slip allow-list): that one model, the verdict word a closed enum, the answer checked for every required key and type, one retry, and a still-malformed answer gives the same no-signal outcome as an AI failure today. The stamp moves with the code, not with the setting. The text-side signature scoring is unchanged.
